clips.send: Common mix-up: Water is not a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen. It takes energy and a chemical reaction to pull the elements apart.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Water is not a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen. It takes energy and a chemical reaction to pull the elements apart.

clips.send: Common mix-up: You need 2 O2, not 1: the products contain 4 O atoms (2 in CO2 + 1 in each H2O).
clips.text: Common mix-up: You need 2 O₂, not 1: the products contain 4 O atoms (2 in CO₂ + 1 in each H₂O).

clips.send: Methane burns. Combustion. Methane (natural gas) burns in oxygen. This is the flame on a gas stove. The products are carbon dioxide and water vapor, both invisible gases. Count: 1 C, 4 H and 4 O on each side. Mass: 80 u, 80 u. In an open kitchen the gases drift away, so it looks like the fuel just disappears. Burn something made of C and H in O2 and you always get CO2 + H2O.
clips.text: Methane burns. Combustion. Methane (natural gas) burns in oxygen. This is the flame on a gas stove.. The products are carbon dioxide and water vapor, both invisible gases.. Count: 1 C, 4 H and 4 O on each side. Mass: 80 u → 80 u.. In an open kitchen the gases drift away, so it looks like the fuel just disappears.. Burn something made of C and H in O₂ and you always get CO₂ + H₂O.

clips.send: Common mix-up: The number of molecules does NOT have to match on both sides. Only the atoms must match.
clips.text: Common mix-up: The number of molecules does NOT have to match on both sides. Only the atoms must match.

clips.send: Hydrogen burns. Synthesis, combustion. First the H–H and O equals O double bond must break. Then the atoms regroup: each O atom bonds to 2 H atoms, making 2 H2O. Count: 4 H and 2 O before, 4 H and 2 O after. Mass: 36 u, 36 u. This reaction releases lots of energy. It powers some rockets and fuel-cell cars. Atoms are like LEGO bricks: take the model apart and build something new. Same bricks, new shape.
clips.text: Hydrogen burns. Synthesis · combustion. First the H–H and O=O bonds must break.. Then the atoms regroup: each O atom bonds to 2 H atoms, making 2 H₂O.. Count: 4 H and 2 O before, 4 H and 2 O after. Mass: 36 u → 36 u.. This reaction releases lots of energy. It powers some rockets and fuel-cell cars.. Atoms are like LEGO bricks: take the model apart and build something new. Same bricks, new shape.

clips.send: Making ammonia. Synthesis. Nitrogen and hydrogen join to make ammonia, which is used to make fertilizer. The strong triple bond in N2 is hard to break, so factories use heat, high pressure and a catalyst. Count: 2 N and 6 H on each side. Mass: 34 u, 34 u. 4 molecules become 2 molecules, but the number of ATOMS stays 8. Molecules can change in number. Atoms can’t.
clips.text: Making ammonia. Synthesis. Nitrogen and hydrogen join to make ammonia, which is used to make fertilizer.. The strong triple bond in N₂ is hard to break, so factories use heat, high pressure and a catalyst.. Count: 2 N and 6 H on each side. Mass: 34 u → 34 u.. 4 molecules become 2 molecules, but the number of ATOMS stays 8.. Molecules can change in number. Atoms can’t.

clips.send: Common mix-up: The 2 in front of H2O is a coefficient (2 molecules). Writing H2O2 instead would make a different substance: hydrogen peroxide!
clips.text: Common mix-up: The 2 in front of H₂O is a coefficient (2 molecules). Writing H₂O₂ instead would make a different substance: hydrogen peroxide!

clips.send: Splitting water. Decomposition. Electricity splits water into hydrogen gas and oxygen gas: the reverse of hydrogen burning. 2 water molecules react to form 2 H2 and 1 O2. Count: 4 H and 2 O on each side. Mass: 36 u, 36 u. One reactant breaking into simpler substances is called decomposition. Decomposition: one thing, two or more things.
clips.text: Splitting water. Decomposition. Electricity splits water into hydrogen gas and oxygen gas: the reverse of hydrogen burning.. 2 water molecules → 2 H₂ + 1 O₂.. Count: 4 H and 2 O on each side. Mass: 36 u → 36 u.. One reactant breaking into simpler substances is called decomposition.. Decomposition: one thing → two or more things.

clips.send: 容易混淆：需要 2 个 O2，而不是 1 个：生成物中共有 4 个氧原子（CO2 中 2 个，每个 H2O 中 1 个）。
clips.text: 容易混淆：需要 2 个 O₂，而不是 1 个：生成物中共有 4 个氧原子（CO₂ 中 2 个，每个 H₂O 中 1 个）。

clips.send: 容易混淆：水不是氢气和氧气的混合物。要把这两种元素分开，需要能量并发生化学反应。
clips.text: 容易混淆：水不是氢气和氧气的混合物。要把这两种元素分开，需要能量并发生化学反应。

clips.send: 氢气燃烧。化合反应 · 燃烧。首先，H–H 键和 氧氧双键要断开。然后原子重新组合：每个氧原子与 2 个氢原子结合，生成 2 个 H2O。清点：反应前 4 个 H、2 个 O，反应后仍是 4 个 H、2 个 O。质量：36 u，36 u。这个反应放出大量能量，可以为火箭和燃料电池汽车提供动力。原子就像乐高积木：拆开旧模型，拼出新模型。积木还是那些，只是形状变了。
clips.text: 氢气燃烧. 化合反应 · 燃烧. 首先，H–H 键和 O=O 键要断开。. 然后原子重新组合：每个氧原子与 2 个氢原子结合，生成 2 个 H₂O。. 清点：反应前 4 个 H、2 个 O，反应后仍是 4 个 H、2 个 O。质量：36 u → 36 u。. 这个反应放出大量能量，可以为火箭和燃料电池汽车提供动力。. 原子就像乐高积木：拆开旧模型，拼出新模型。积木还是那些，只是形状变了。

clips.send: 合成氨。化合反应。氮气和氢气结合生成氨，氨可以用来制造化肥。N2 中的三键很牢固，所以工厂要用高温、高压和催化剂。清点：两边都是 2 个 N、6 个 H。质量：34 u，34 u。4 个分子变成了 2 个分子，但原子总数始终是 8 个。分子个数可以改变，原子个数不会改变。
clips.text: 合成氨. 化合反应. 氮气和氢气结合生成氨，氨可以用来制造化肥。. N₂ 中的三键很牢固，所以工厂要用高温、高压和催化剂。. 清点：两边都是 2 个 N、6 个 H。质量：34 u → 34 u。. 4 个分子变成了 2 个分子，但原子总数始终是 8 个。. 分子个数可以改变，原子个数不会改变。

clips.send: 容易混淆：H2O 前面的 2 是系数（2 个分子）。如果写成 H2O2，就变成另一种物质——过氧化氢了！
clips.text: 容易混淆：H₂O 前面的 2 是系数（2 个分子）。如果写成 H₂O₂，就变成另一种物质——过氧化氢了！

clips.send: 电解水。分解反应。通电使水分解成氢气和氧气，正好是氢气燃烧的逆过程。2 个水分子 生成 2 个 H2 和 1 个 O2。清点：两边都是 4 个 H、2 个 O。质量：36 u，36 u。一种反应物分解成几种更简单的物质，叫做分解反应。分解反应：一变多。
clips.text: 电解水. 分解反应. 通电使水分解成氢气和氧气，正好是氢气燃烧的逆过程。. 2 个水分子 → 2 个 H₂ + 1 个 O₂。. 清点：两边都是 4 个 H、2 个 O。质量：36 u → 36 u。. 一种反应物分解成几种更简单的物质，叫做分解反应。. 分解反应：一变多。

clips.send: 甲烷燃烧。燃烧反应。甲烷（天然气）在氧气中燃烧，燃气灶的火焰就是这个反应。生成物是二氧化碳和水蒸气，都是看不见的气体。清点：两边都是 1 个 C、4 个 H、4 个 O。质量：80 u，80 u。在敞开的厨房里，生成的气体飘走了，所以燃料看起来像是“消失”了。含碳和氢的物质在氧气中燃烧，生成物总是 CO2 和 H2O。
clips.text: 甲烷燃烧. 燃烧反应. 甲烷（天然气）在氧气中燃烧，燃气灶的火焰就是这个反应。. 生成物是二氧化碳和水蒸气，都是看不见的气体。. 清点：两边都是 1 个 C、4 个 H、4 个 O。质量：80 u → 80 u。. 在敞开的厨房里，生成的气体飘走了，所以燃料看起来像是“消失”了。. 含碳和氢的物质在氧气中燃烧，生成物总是 CO₂ 和 H₂O。

clips.send: 容易混淆：两边的分子个数不必相等，只有每种原子的个数必须相等。
clips.text: 容易混淆：两边的分子个数不必相等，只有每种原子的个数必须相等。
